title: Ascorbic acid, 21 CFR 182.3013 and 182.8013: substances generally recognized as safe
journal: Code of Federal Regulations, title 21, part 182, subpart D (Chemical Preservatives) and subpart I (Nutrients), read in the electronic Code of Federal Regulations, up to date as of 20 October 2026
funder: US Food and Drug Administration; the text is federal regulation codified by the Office of the Federal Register.
result: Sections 182.3013 (chemical preservatives) and 182.8013 (nutrients) each list ascorbic acid and state: 'This substance is generally recognized as safe when used in accordance with good manufacturing practice.'
